edges.relationship: HD Hyundai Electric builds the 600MWh Anjwa BESS (ESS, power control equipment) for Jumin Sandeulbaram Power under an EPC contract

contracts.signal: Anjwa BESS power plant construction EPC contract KRW 181,156M signed 2025-12-19, completion deadline 2026-12-31 (filed term to 2027-03-31); 17.54% complete at 2026-06-30, KRW 32.1B recognised and KRW 24.7B collected in H1 2026; contract asset KRW 4,928M. HD Hyundai Electric invested KRW 6,691M for a 19.9% stake (equity-method associate). 600MWh project won in Korea's 1st central contract market ESS tender; only awardee targeting completion within 2026.
